entries.reason: Internal rollback and queue copies use the owning modules' typed Protobuf snapshots rather than JSON projections.
entries.schema: Definitions rollback uses definitions:registry version 2; production copy uses production:queue version 8.
entries.version: Both transfers emit the current typed Protobuf version of their authoritative owner.
entries.migration: Legacy JSON import remains at the Definitions and Production compatibility boundaries; internal transfers need no JSON migration.
entries.unknown_fields: Both owners reject unknown Protobuf fields recursively before replacing state.
entries.restore_atomicity: Definitions restores a detached candidate on failed import; production copy constructs a detached queue and publishes it only after restore succeeds.

entries.reason: RTS calls the existing Definitions and Production typed persistence interfaces for internal transactions; this change adds no event, script, or tool face.

trim.absent_profile: No L1-L4 trim claim is made for this internal change.

entries.thread_affinity: Import and component copy run on their owning simulation thread with no callbacks during the binary transfer.
cost_notes: Rollback and copy cost linear time in the retained definitions, tasks, events and dynamic body bytes per operation.
